items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Like, maybe the third alto player or Johnny wouldn't be there

ctx.x: Yeah, I'm sure that's where a lot of it came from. And sometimes Duke would put their names on it and sometimes Duke wouldn't put their names on it. That was sort of the way the band worked. And he took from those around him, and then those around him sometimes from him -- and that's the way it went.

Well, he was I guess the loosest bandleader there ever was. He didn't care... That's what I saw. If he had a bass player and a drummer, he'd start anyway. And I know a lot of the wild sounds came about that way. Like, maybe the third alto player or Johnny wouldn't be there, so the trombone, being in the register, although...you just change the clef sign, and it's the same thing.
